name: lysine methyltransferase 2B

function.text: KMT2B encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2B. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity and histone H3K4 monomethyltransferase activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder with motor features (autosomal dominant); dystonia 28, childhood-onset (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Hepatocellular Carcinoma; Vulva/Vagina. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
